tier_reason: Third-party gemmi shootout with public benchmark code (1d.cpp, 2d.cpp, Makefile building libmuFFT SSE/SSE3/AVX variants and kissfft), GCC 8 -O3 stated, CPU i7-5600U stated; muFFT and KissFFT rows match the record.

corrections.compiler_and_flags: GCC 8 (g++-8) -O3 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic, no -march (per Makefile); FFTW3 from Ubuntu 18.04 packages
corrections.caveats: 1D KissFFT figure (6553 ns) is scalar; SIMD muFFT vs scalar KissFFT inflates the ratio (muFFT NS 4024 ns vs 6553 ns is the like-for-like). 2D 256x256: muFFT 259 us vs kissfft 1583 us (SIMD) / muFFT NS 1092 us. Slower than FFTW meas. in 1D n=512 (719 vs 588 ns); power-of-two sizes only. GitHub shows MIT (COPYING is MIT; page also mentions GPL-2.0 dual licensing). No commits since Feb 2019.

notes: Numbers verified on the gemmi README. Last commit 2019-02-15, so abandoned.

tier_reason: gemmi shootout code (1d.cpp, 1d-r.cpp, Makefile compiling pffft/pffft.c with -O3) is public with GCC 8 and i7-5600U stated; pffft and KissFFT rows match the record. The measured code was Pommier's bitbucket original, whose single-precision core this fork carries.

corrections.license: FFTPACK/NCAR (UCAR) BSD-style license (no SPDX id; terms equivalent to BSD-3-Clause)
corrections.caveats: Benchmark measured Julien Pommier's original bitbucket pffft, not this fork's additions (double precision, etc.). SIMD pffft 1255 ns vs scalar KissFFT 6553 ns at n=512 C2C is 5.2x (derived from page data); like-for-like scalar pffft NS 3792 ns vs 6553 ns. Slower than FFTW (585 vs 321 ns est. at n=256). License is the FFTPACK/UCAR BSD-style text, not a standard SPDX id. Complex sizes must be multiples of 16 (real: 32) with SIMD.

notes: Fork of Pommier's bitbucket pffft (README says so); active (commit 2026-09-29). hayguen/pffft_benchmarks could offer per-CPU results for the fork itself.

tier_reason: gemmi shootout code (3d.cpp, 3d-r.cpp, 2d.cpp, Makefile) is public with GCC 8 -O3 and i7-5600U stated; the 3D R2C/C2C pocketfft vs kissfft numbers match the page.

corrections.compiler_and_flags: GCC 8 (g++-8) -O3 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic; pocketfft rows built with SSE or AVX (-march=native for pocketfft.o per Makefile)
corrections.caveats: Benchmark run by a user of the library (gemmi author) on the gitlab mpcdf cpp branch, which this GitHub repo mirrors. 1D rows used the older C version (double precision, not vectorized) and are slower than FFTW. FFTW came from Ubuntu 18.04 binaries, not self-built. MKL 2019 is faster (61 ms vs 97 ms R2C 256^3). Old CPU and compiler. KissFFT rows are scalar builds. The repo README gives no numbers.

notes: GitHub repo says it is a fork of the gitlab.mpcdf.mpg.de/mtr/pocketfft canonical repo, kept to ease contributions; the benchmark used the gitlab cpp branch. Commits page shows 2026-06-30.
